title: Synthetic vs User-generated Queries Classifier
short: Sort a keyword list into the short queries people type and the longer, denser ones AI search generates, and see which signals drove each label.
needs: Nothing: it runs in your browser
inputs: One query, or a CSV with one query per line or a column named keyword or query
outputs: A label, score and reasons for each query, plus a CSV export of every feature and result
how: Start in Feature extraction with one query to see the signals the classifiers read.
Open the Rule-based classifier and compare a short query with a long technical one.
Upload your keyword CSV and check the split between user and synthetic queries.
Adjust the rule thresholds or the ML threshold. The results on screen update as you go.
Export the results CSV and check a sample of each label by eye.
note: Both classifiers use fixed rules and weights, not a model trained on your data, and entity detection relies on capital letters, so use the labels to sort a list rather than as proof of where a query came from.
